name: F3_ungroup_of_a_minimum_of_string_vectors
description: Task 12.1, F3. The cumulative or rolling minimum or maximum of a column of vectors of strings. Java's result column is a vector without a component type, which a client receives as a list of strings as it does Oxhaven's typed column; after ungroup Java's column is java.lang.Object and Oxhaven's java.lang.String (sortable).
